summary.scope: Paired production opt-in storage comparison on one Linux host; no general speed or memory claim.

environment.scope: Same installed exporter and copied saved program, alternating none/zlib pairs. GNU time covers fresh wrapper/JVM/export, excluding analysis, validators and GDB. CPU includes descendants; RSS is process-family high water, not summed memory. Warm caches and host load uncontrolled. Profiles are separate from timed populations.

none.scope: One profiled export; elapsed wall time including waits, not CPU. Outer export includes child phases. Startup/project opening are outside export. Native production includes Java DIE construction, JNA/native work and section materialization.

zlib.scope: One profiled export; elapsed wall time including waits, not CPU. Outer export includes child phases. Startup/project opening are outside export. Native production includes Java DIE construction, JNA/native work and section materialization.

limits: Warm caches and host load uncontrolled; one Linux host
No general speed or memory improvement claim
Known decompilation timeout preserved, not excluded from timing
Sandbox firmware code runs on Linux; not bare-metal validation
